title: Yonto index
description: A repo's document, as far as Yonto reads it (kangzj/lantern-tv#606, docs/design/2026-09-23-the-app-reads-every-index.md). `plugins` lists the plugins to install, Yonto's own list. `sites` is the TVBox 仓 / XPTV list of catalogs, where Yonto's own entries are `type` 50 and say what they are in `ext.yontoType`, with the type's payload in `ext.config`; every other entry is somebody else's and is described only enough to be told apart. A document carries either list or both.
$comment: Lenient about everyone else's entries, because a curator merging ours into a stranger's 仓 must not be refused for the stranger's fields, and a reader skips and counts what it can't use rather than refusing the document. A type-50 entry's config is described by contracts/yonto-types/<yontoType>.schema.json. A plugin is never a `sites` entry (kangzj/yonto, 2026-10-09): a plugin is not a site, and a TVBox player ignores a key it does not know, so `plugins` needs none of the fields that used to keep one out of that player's site list.

plugins.description: Mirrored as IndexReader's MAX_ENTRIES on a device, which refuses a longer list rather than reading part of it.

sites.description: Mirrored as IndexReader's MAX_ENTRIES on a device, which refuses a longer list rather than reading part of it.

plugin.description: A plugin to install: enough to list it and compare versions without downloading anything, and checked against the downloaded manifest before anything installs. `url` is the versioned zip with its sha256, exactly the link a viewer could paste. A reader skips and counts one it cannot read, and a second entry for an id already listed.

handles.$comment: Copied from the manifest, so a repo can offer the handler of a type without downloading every zip it lists (docs/design/2026-09-23-the-app-reads-every-index.md, *Types*).

not.$comment: FongMi reads `type` as an Integer and turns a string into an empty site, so a Yonto entry typed "50" is not the same entry to every reader. Other entries' string types are theirs to keep.

yontoEntry.description: A Yonto catalog entry. 50 is the only number Yonto takes; a new kind of entry is a new `yontoType`, never a new number.

yontoType.description: What this entry is. A short id is Yonto's own and has a schema under contracts/yonto-types/; anybody else's type is reverse-DNS. A reader skips and counts a type it doesn't know.
